coordinates.source: LDraw right-handed, -Y up; translations in LDU
coordinates.part_local_axes: converted by the same basis B; catalog source coordinates remain LDraw-local

step_semantics: Explicit STEP/ROTSTEP boundaries preserve parent-local order. ROTSTEP affects view metadata only. A referenced subassembly enters its parent at final state; no interleaved global child execution order is invented.
limitations: Assembly state and authored STEP boundaries only; not robot actions or an executable global subassembly schedule.
No physical connection, stability, grasp, collision, reachability, force, or calibration validation is performed.
Explicit STEP/ROTSTEP boundaries are interpreted. ROTSTEP view metadata is preserved without changing part poses; page layout/cameras/rendering are not reconstructed.
DAT references are atomic parts, not recursively expanded part-library geometry; unknown DAT parts are retained with warnings.
Catalog bounds/connectors are supplied metadata, not exact physical geometry or evidence of a valid mating connection.
1 LDU = 0.4 mm is the LDraw nominal approximation; poses are not calibrated robot targets.
